diagnosticFindings.explanation: The inherited uniform local XY scale shrinks cover width and height toward a pivot above the eye. Pushing cover vertices forward to clear partial-state eye geometry introduces a floating boundary at full closure. The current sampled-envelope method does not solve natural eyelid motion.
